Before you start this task, webhooks need to be inactive. If webhooks are on, all the data will sync into Salesforce the minute it is loaded into your Stripe Account. ::: The first step is to move any historical data from your existing gateway account over to your new {{variable.Product_Stripe}} account. Once that is complete, you will need to sync customer, payment method, transaction, and payout data from {{variable.Product_Stripe}} to {{variable.Product_Salesforce}}. Click the links below for more information about each step. 1. [Instructions](/v1/docs/payments-historical-sync-stripe-instructions) 2. [Customers](/v1/docs/payments-historical-sync-stripe-customers) 3. [Payment Methods](/v1/docs/payments-historical-sync-stripe-payment-methods) 4. [Charges / Refunds](/v1/docs/payments-historical-sync-stripe-charges-refunds) 5. [Payouts](/v1/docs/payments-historical-sync-stripe-payouts) ## Move Data from a Non-Stripe Account to Your New Stripe Account Is your data located somewhere other than at {{variable.Product_Stripe}}? If your data is with a different gateway and you want to move it to {{variable.Product_Stripe}}, {{variable.Product_Stripe}} provides a way to move your Customer and Payment Method records from your old/current payment gateway. To start the process, reach out to [Stripe Support](https://stripe.com/docs/payments/account/data-migrations/pan-import){target="_blank"}.
